name: PoweredBeltsExtended
title: Powered Belts Extended
author: DiabolicWolf
description: Belts now need power. All of them. Including all the modded ones. Mod by Romner_set: https://mods.factorio.com/user/Romner_set. Original version: https://mods.factorio.com/mod/PoweredBelts. I've modified the behaviour of powered belts (and others) to use buffer capacity of x*1kJ instead of x*17J and the entities turn off when they have less than required energy defined through setting (default = 500J). You could exploit it otherwise having 1 solar panel powering a huge amount of belts that won't slow down due to limitations of this mod.
